contentText:
Olivia Dean nabs another entry into the top 10 with “So Easy,” while “Golden” and “Ordinary” rise, but who will take No. 1 this week?

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated March 28. Last week’s Harry debut falls to 10. Olivia Dean has a new top 10 with “So Easy.” “The Fate of Ophelia” is still at eight. “Opalite” is up to seven. “Stateside” is locked at six. The Oscars helped send “Golden” up to five. “Ordinary” climbs to four. “I Just Might” remains at three, as does “Man I Need” at two, while grabbing a fourth week at No. 1 is Ella Langley with “Choosin’ Texas.”
